_comment: Portable binaries bundled into Sound Cache.app (Contents/.../bin). Fetched and sha256-verified by packaging/fetch_vendor.sh; the build refuses anything that doesn't match. Keep these on patched releases: Node had 10 CVEs fixed on 2026-10-20/21 (incl. an exploited Brotli RCE, CVE-2026-111497), and the old ffmpeg-static build was FFmpeg 6.1.1 from 2023.
